caption: The drawing depicts a single dark-colored figure of a man riding a horse, both rendered in shades of black and gray. The man is dressed in a historical military-style uniform, including a tricorn hat, a long coat with buttons, and knee-high boots. His hands rest on the reins, and his face is turned slightly to his left. The horse is shown in profile, with one front leg lifted as if stepping forward, and the tail is slightly raised and curled at the end. Both the rider and the horse are placed atop a flat, ground-like base, suggesting a statue or figurine. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, with no additional elements or scenery. The artist’s signature is visible in the lower right corner.
title: Iron Officer on Horse
